urn:eigenius:core:description: Identity EigenTT term on `diffeq:OdeProblem`. Body is a `program:Var` referencing the bound parameter, so this Lambda has type `OdeProblem -> OdeProblem`. Realises the typed middle `m` of the Catalyst -> DiffEq Comorphism: both endpoints speak the same OdeProblem shape (the Catalyst-side ExportFormat extracts a FormulaTerm-typed OdeProblem via `compile_to_ode`; the DiffEq-side ImportFormat takes the same shape as input), so the cross-institution boundary needs no payload translation. The actual compilation work happens inside the ExportFormat's `procedure` — same pattern as the Symbolics -> IntervalArithmetic identity comorphism, lifted from FormulaTerm to OdeProblem.

Cross-institution Comorphism — Catalyst -> DiffEq. The triple (s, m, t) where s = `ef_cat_to_ode_input` (Catalyst-side compilation of a CatalystToOdeInput to a FormulaTerm-typed OdeProblem via `compile_to_ode`), m = `m_id_ode_problem` (the identity Lambda on OdeProblem), t = `if_diffeq_problem` (DiffEq-side reify of the OdeProblem payload). The chain-side formalisation of D27 §4.4.4: a typed compilation pipeline from a chain-committed reaction network to a chain-committed integrator-ready problem. Marked `exact: false` because mass-action ODE compilation is faithful to the network's *deterministic* limit but the network admits other dynamical interpretations (jumps, SDEs) under the same structure — same exactness story as D27 §4.4.4 sketches.
